data.standardized_narrative: The report discloses gross claims outstanding (closing reserves) at 31 December 2013 of GBP 205.059m (used as opening reserves at 1 January 2014). The document does not present a clear, gross-amount prior-year reserve movement (movement in prior years) figure that can be extracted unambiguously from the notes or narrative, so no prior year development amount is reported here. Gross written premium for 2014 is reported as GBP 298.675m.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' row (31 December 2013 closing = opening at 1 Jan 2014). The scanned report images made some numeric cells difficult to disambiguate; no explicit 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure was found in the visible notes or narrative. The claims development/technical reserve reconciliation triangle or explicit gross prior-year movement could not be reliably extracted from the provided images; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. Gross premium total taken from the Profit & Loss (Technical Account) top-line 'Gross written premiums' (explicit). Segmental premium mix table could not be reliably transcribed from images.
